outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: Georgetown, estimated population 250,000 ( 1998), is the capital and largest city of Guyana, located in the Demerara-Mahaica region.

outgoing.name: George III of the United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: It was renamed Georgetown on 29 April 1812 in honour of King George III.

outgoing.name: Gold
outgoing.excerpt: Businesses include: Demerara sugar, timber, bauxite, gold, and diamonds are exported through Georgetown's harbour.

outgoing.name: Netherlands
outgoing.excerpt: Originally, the capital of the Demerara-Essequibo colony was located on Borselen Island in the Demerara River under the administration of the Dutch.
